translations.web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
translations.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
translations.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
translations.asv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
